Location_Name.meaning: Recorded geographic label; neither applicant nor payee identifier
Location_Name.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

Location_Type.meaning: LGA or SAL. SAL means suburb/locality in ABS geography; LGA includes unincorporated areas, not necessarily an elected council
Location_Type.definition_verification: Values verified; ABS SAL definition verified; export boundary vintage unknown

Location_code.meaning: Recorded geographic code; preserve as text. ABS-like values; geographic vintage and historical boundary crosswalk not specified
Location_code.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

STATE.meaning: Recorded state/territory label; enforce state when linking similarly named locations
STATE.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

event_name.meaning: Human-readable event description containing AGRN and sometimes onset/end dates; not a single measure or decision
event_name.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

agrn.meaning: Australian Government Reference Number identifying a registered disaster; does not identify a funding application, package or independent physical event
agrn.definition_verification: Official DisasterAssist pages label matching AGRNs

cat_A.meaning: Binary recorded Category A flag. Policy category: personal hardship/distress; export zero encoding undocumented
cat_A.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

cat_B.meaning: Binary recorded Category B flag. Policy category includes essential public asset recovery and other loans/subsidies; export zero encoding undocumented
cat_B.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

cat_C.meaning: Binary recorded C activation indicator; cannot interpret as receipt. Category C comprises recovery funds or sector recovery measures. 0 only establishes recorded flag absence, not eligible denial. Mapping of multiple measures to flag undocumented
cat_C.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

cat_D.meaning: Binary recorded D activation indicator for exceptional relief/recovery beyond A–C; heterogeneous programs. 0 does not establish eligible denial or no funding
cat_D.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

highest_drfa_category_group.meaning: Observed broad A/B or C/D grouping (and any other observed values); overlaps target flags, so never a predictor of C/D
highest_drfa_category_group.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

AGDRP.meaning: Recorded Australian Government Disaster Recovery Payment indicator; separate individual-assistance scheme. Flag does not report payment amount or approved council receipt
AGDRP.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

DRA.meaning: Recorded Disaster Recovery Allowance indicator; income support to eligible individuals, not council assistance receipt
DRA.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

hazard_type.meaning: Recorded hazard grouping; one missing entry; event names may contain multiple hazards. Not intensity/damage/need
hazard_type.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent

disaster_start_date.meaning: Recorded disaster onset date; not category approval, LGA addition, application, announcement or cash receipt date
disaster_start_date.definition_verification: Interpretation consistent with records; publisher field-level definition absent
